info.title: Origin Trace local HTTP API
info.description: Source-backed description of the Origin Trace Rust backend HTTP interface. Not a new server or a promise of full native-app parity. No credential authentication is implemented. Every /api/ GET and every POST requires Host to name localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 with the exact listening port; cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site is rejected. If Origin is present it must be HTTP, local, same port, without credentials/query/fragment. Nonbrowser CLI clients can omit Origin. Use local access only. Schemas explicitly marked partial retain source-specific gaps; x-max-utf8-bytes is documentary, not a standard JSON Schema validator keyword.

CollectionAction.description: Full replacement, not patch. IDs are positive; root folder id=1/name=API Collection/parent_id=null must remain. Parent references, uniqueness, depth <=4, header restrictions and cumulative UTF-8 budgets are enforced by api_collection.py. Stale expected_generation returns 409. This stores templates; it does not execute requests.

AnalystAction.description: Run IDs and script IDs must be positive. Run requires the current saved JavaScript script, matching source and workspace generation. selected_artifact.sensitive=true requires confirmed_sensitive=true. Cancellation is a separate concurrent request. Replacement enforces root id=1/name=Analyst Workspace, tree and cumulative size limits in local_analyst.py.
